blockers.issue: The bootstrap does not fail closed. In an ordinary shell, test ! -e can fail and mkdir -p/cd/clones/checkouts/copies/patching still continue. A failed clone into an existing api/cli directory can consequently be followed by checkout and patch operations against someone else's checkout; a failed cd can redirect subsequent work into the caller's directory.
blockers.required_change: Run the bootstrap in an explicit fail-fast shell/subshell, reject non-absolute paths and existing paths including dangling symlinks, use mkdir without -p for the new workspace leaf, and stop on every failed clone/checkout/copy/apply check. The existing-workspace refusal must occur before any mutation. Apply fail-fast sequencing to the manual build/test block at lines 285-301 as well so failed tests/builds cannot be obscured by later successful help commands.

suggestions.issue: The toolchain Dockerfile copies no workspace files, but context: .. exposes the entire future workspace to the builder unnecessarily. Git ignores do not constrain Docker build context.
suggestions.recommendation: Use context: . with dockerfile: Dockerfile, or an explicit restrictive .dockerignore. Retain the separate workspace bind mount. This is preventive hardening, not a claim that secrets were transmitted.

suggestions.issue: Detached Compose startup only waits for database health, not API readiness. The single curl can race API startup and has no explicit duration bound.
suggestions.recommendation: Document a finite readiness loop or bounded curl retries including connection-refused handling, per-attempt connect/request timeouts and an overall deadline; stop before import when readiness never succeeds.

suggestions.issue: An adjacent current operator guide still advertises interactive cost estimation and a dynamic monthly cost calculator, contradicting the retired panels and new root README. Discovered during the scoped documentation search; not part of the seven requested review files.
suggestions.recommendation: Remove only those stale costing claims or point to configs/cost/README.md; preserve the profile-edit/export instructions.
